decision_scores_score_xor_unscorable_che.name: decision_scores_score_xor_unscorable_check
decision_scores_score_xor_unscorable_che.value:
("decision_scores"."score" is not null and "decision_scores"."unscorable_reason" is null)
        or ("decision_scores"."score" is null and "decision_scores"."unscorable_reason" is not null)

decisions_origin_match_check.name: decisions_origin_match_check
decisions_origin_match_check.value:
("decisions"."origin_kind" = 'signal' and "decisions"."signal_id" is not null and "decisions"."contemplated_operation_id" is null)
        or ("decisions"."origin_kind" = 'contemplated_operation' and "decisions"."contemplated_operation_id" is not null and "decisions"."signal_id" is null)
